description: The conversation experiment world's grounding vocabulary (Wave 3). One RelationCue: 'replay' — a promoted conversation concern (reply_fix / knowledge / instruction with experiment-signal content) carries a ['replay','TURN','in','CONVERSATION'] relation, and this cue is what lets ground_concern's held-lexicon pass ground that head so the experiment composer's conversation branch fires (mint rule pinned to the 'conversation' WorldInstance; SeedDelta carries a targeted reply-rule ablation instead of an ARC acting variant; the dispatched child is scripts/convo_child_run.py, which replays the recorded chat corpus and scores flagged-turn-fixed minus regressions). Kept out of the frozen relation_vocabulary seed: this is ablatable conversation-world vocabulary, not foundational grounding.
